topic.title: License Notes
topic.shortdesc: Important information about how floating licenses are consumed and released in .

body.p: uses a floating license mechanism, where the license key is stored on a server and users consume license seats from a common pool. Note the following:

ul.li: For the licensing mechanism to work properly, your browser must accept cookies. Otherwise, will not load.

Each browser consumes a license. If you use multiple browsers (for example, Firefox and Chrome) to access at the same time on the same system, you will consume multiple licenses. However, multiple tabs in the same browser consume a single license.
A license is automatically released after 30 minutes of inactivity. When you resume work, if no licenses are available, you can still save the documents you are currently working on.
On desktop systems, you can release the license immediately by closing all editor tabs.
